arStrings.szText: Hope. That is what he wrote of. The hope that burns like a fire in the darkest night. The hope that burns in your heart when all seems lost. Embrace Akarat’s truth, and your doubts, and your fears, they will burn away and reveal a path forward.
Confident and clear. Speaking to a crowd of pilgrims. In contrast to Bnatros' earlier preaching, Adone is good at this.
